subject.title: [Bug]: Agent self-update bypasses update.run and uses raw npm global upgrade without restarting gateway

question: Should OpenClaw hard-block raw global OpenClaw package-manager updates through exec, and should that policy land via the linked PR or a replacement?
rationale: Blocking this command class is the likely correct safety fix, but it intentionally changes operator-visible exec behavior and the existing candidate PR needs maintainer-owned rework/proof before the protected issue can close.

options.title: Land a shared-guard fix
options.body: Port or replace the candidate PR so the detector lives in the shared exec-control guard, preserves `openclaw update`, and proves real rejection before process launch.

options.title: Allow raw updates with explicit restart policy
options.body: Keep raw package-manager commands possible only if maintainers define and test a visible restart-required or mandatory-restart contract.

options.title: Defer to broader update hardening
options.body: Leave this issue open until the broader update/rollback lifecycle work decides the permanent boundary for package swaps and stale dist imports.

recommendation.title: Land a shared-guard fix
recommendation.body: Port or replace the candidate PR so the detector lives in the shared exec-control guard, preserves `openclaw update`, and proves real rejection before process launch.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source history ties this person most directly to the shared exec-control and update surfaces that would carry the decision.
